note: Hand-written file contract for the R08 (Joseph) normal enemies H1-H3. Same 32 px rules as art 03 / R02-R07 (PPU 32, pivot (16,1), art faces right, flipX once on the parent, binary alpha). All three chase and touch only: no new projectile, dash, binding debuff, growth, shared health or damage-ground art. Gameplay numbers belong to Core and the catalog.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R07

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y. The H2 chain is part of this rule: its whole swing stays inside the clip

assets.use: chase loop: a crouching shadow imp with jagged shadow spikes on its head, two huge staring green eyes and a green grin, clawed hands clutched to its chest, wisps trailing behind. Look only: no debuff or ranged attack

slow chase loop: a hooded spirit whose chest is a small iron cage, swinging one chain with an iron weight round itself, 90 degrees per frame (right, front, left, behind). The chain is look only: it stays inside the 32 px clip with a margin, never reaches toward the player and has no reach, hook or binding effect

chase loop: a gaunt beast with ribs and spine showing and a long bony neck, chewing a sheaf of grain held in its jaws. It stays the same thin size in every frame (no growth), and the grain is only in its mouth: nothing is dropped or left on the ground

notProduced.chain reach / binding effect: not made on purpose: H2 has no binding debuff; the chain swing is look only and stays in the clip
notProduced.grain on the ground / growth stages: not made on purpose: no grain piles, crop decals or bigger H3 variants, so nothing reads as damage ground or an eat-and-grow mechanic
notProduced.death / hit clips: not in the R08 brief; the existing shared enemy hit/death handling applies

motifs.source: Genesis 37:3-11 (the brothers' envy of Joseph), 39:20-40:23 (the prison) and 41:27-57 (the years of famine). Creative adaptation for the game.
motifs.h1: envy as a crouching shadow imp with staring green eyes (a created monster; not Joseph's brothers or any person)
motifs.h2: the prison as a hooded spirit whose chest is an iron cage, swinging a chain (a created monster; not Joseph, a prisoner, a jailer or any person)
motifs.h3: the famine as a gaunt beast devouring grain (a created monster; not a starving person, and not the thin cows of Pharaoh's dream)
motifs.excluded: Joseph, his brothers, Jacob, Potiphar and his wife, the cupbearer, the baker, Pharaoh, prisoners, hungry people, livestock and God are never enemies or enemy effects. No human figures are drawn
